decisions.decision_text: The September 30, 2026 first production release must include responsive web access. The team may use a desktop-first design and implementation sequence, but mobile responsiveness must be completed before production launch. There will not be a separate post-launch mobile fast-follow for this requirement.

original_evidence.quote: - Must be accessible on mobile (responsive design)
"Mobile is important but I don't want to compromise the desktop experience. Maybe we do desktop first and mobile as a fast follow."
